prompts.prompt: Refactor src/CreateProjectForm.tsx to our form stack (react-hook-form with a zod schema) and our component rules (Cloudscape only). Keep the same fields and the same onSubmit payload. Dependencies are listed in package.json but not installed and there is no network, so you cannot compile; be careful. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill's standards are specific: typed useForm<T>() with zodResolver, no useState for form state, messages from constraint constants rather than hardcoded strings, Box/SpaceBetween instead of native div/span/button, no inline styles, no any, memoized handlers. A competent refactor without it often keeps the hardcoded messages, leaves a <span> hint or style prop, or types the payload loosely.

floor_checks.text: Typed useForm with zod resolver and no useState
floor_checks.check: grep -qE 'useForm<[A-Za-z]+' src/CreateProjectForm.tsx && grep -q zodResolver src/CreateProjectForm.tsx && ! grep -q 'useState' src/CreateProjectForm.tsx

floor_checks.text: No native HTML, inline styles, or any
floor_checks.check: test -f src/CreateProjectForm.tsx && ! grep -qE '<(div|span|button|input|a)[ >]' src/CreateProjectForm.tsx && ! grep -q 'style={{' src/CreateProjectForm.tsx && ! grep -qE ':\s*any\b|<any>|as any' src/CreateProjectForm.tsx

rubric.pass: Schema built with zod using PROJECT_NAME_MIN/MAX and VALIDATION_MESSAGES; Controller (or useFormContext) per field; FormField wraps each input with errorText from formState; submit via handleSubmit
rubric.partial: RHF + zod used but messages still hardcoded or one field bypasses RHF

rubric.pass: Same three fields, payload { name, region: <value string>, terms }, region option typed (not any), terms must be true, hint text kept via Box
rubric.partial: Payload shape or hint changed slightly

rubric.pass: Calls out that switching to VALIDATION_MESSAGES changes user-visible strings ('Name is required' becomes 'Project name is required.') as an assumption
Imports match usage, no invented Cloudscape props, onChange handlers adapted to Cloudscape detail events; no unrelated changes
rubric.fail: Several invented APIs or obvious compile errors

focus: Would this compile and behave the same?

prompts.prompt: Add a rule to src/BookingForm.tsx: the end date must be after the start date, with the error shown on the end date field. Export the schema and add a unit test file for it next to the component. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill says cross-field validation uses .refine (not .transform), messages come from constraint constants, and tests assert actual messages rather than existence. Without it, models often hardcode the message, attach the error at the form root, or write tests that only check success === false.

floor_checks.text: Cross-field rule via refine/superRefine on endDate, message from constants
floor_checks.check: grep -qE '\.(super)?[Rr]efine\(' src/BookingForm.tsx && grep -q 'VALIDATION_MESSAGES.endBeforeStart' src/BookingForm.tsx && grep -qE "path:\s*\[\s*['\"]endDate" src/BookingForm.tsx

floor_checks.text: A test file exists next to the component

rubric.pass: .refine with path ['endDate'], message VALIDATION_MESSAGES.endBeforeStart, no .transform; schema exported and BookingFormValues still inferred from it
rubric.partial: Correct rule but message hardcoded or path missing
rubric.fail: Rule in a component effect or onSubmit

rubric.pass: Compares Cloudscape DatePicker 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings correctly (Date parse or lexical compare of ISO format) and decides equal dates explicitly (strictly after = equal fails)

prompts.prompt: The details panel in src/DetailsPanel.tsx jumps around when the fields prop changes and renders label/value pairs by hand. Fix it the Cloudscape way, changing only what is needed. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.

floor_checks.text: Uses KeyValuePairs, no native divs, fixed numeric columns
